summary: Siskiyou NF lookout in Curry County, OR: a 40-foot L-4 tower built 1940 or 1941 (sources differ), abandoned 1954 and now gone; no current site description found.

facts.design: 40-foot pole L-4 tower (register and firelookout.com); 40-foot round timber tower (Oregon Lookouts, quoting a Siskiyou NF history)
facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com say the tower was abandoned in 1954 and is now gone; no source describes what remains at the site

staffing.status: staffed 100 days in 1941, reporting to Agness Ranger Station; no later staffing found

facts.access_note: Only access remark: a 1942 survey note that the station was not visited because it was inaccessible; no source on current public access

events.note: 1933 Camp Agness CCC newspaper item: Elwin Florance returned to his post on the Bob's Garden emergency lookout; not clear whether that was the later tower
May 1940 Coos Bay Times item (quoted on Oregon Lookouts): three new lookouts for the Siskiyou, one on Bob's Garden peak in the Agness district
May 1940 forest plan entry (Plans, Guard Placement, Siskiyou NF), quoted on Oregon Lookouts: provides detection for a considerable area of high hazard burns
Siskiyou NF history as quoted on Oregon Lookouts: 40-foot round timber tower constructed, with a three-quarter-mile spur trail; the register and firelookout.com date the build to 1941
Register and firelookout.com: built in 1941 as a 40-foot pole L-4 tower
Staffed 100 days; reporting station was Agness Ranger Station; communications by early radio and forest line

Coast and Geodetic Survey description (1942) places its station at the center of the Forest Service lookout house; the house is described as square with a pyramidal roof; the station was not visited because it was inaccessible
Abandoned in 1954 per the register and firelookout.com
Registered November 23, 2010 as US 767, OR 176; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the tower to 1941. A Siskiyou National Forest history, quoted on the Oregon Lookouts page, says a 40-foot round timber tower was constructed in 1940. Both dates are kept as events and the story reports both; the year is not settled.

notes_for_editor: Built year conflicts: 1941 (register, firelookout.com) vs 1940 (Siskiyou NF history quoted on Oregon Lookouts). Design wording differs: pole L-4 vs round timber. The 1933 emergency-lookout item may refer to an earlier structure; not confirmed. The 1942 NGS description is read only through the Oregon Lookouts page, which quotes it. Location differs slightly: firelookout.com says about 30 miles northeast of Gold Beach; the NGS text says about 8 miles air line NE of Agness; not reconciled. No source describes the site today or whether the public can reach it; the only access remark is the 1942 note that the station was not visited because it was inaccessible. The brief's access 'unknown' is kept out of facts because no source supports a level.
